regions.region: page 1 title, metadata, abstract, and Supporting Information notice
regions.finding: Verified the source title and current one-pot Au/TiO2-catalyzed allenone/alkynylamine reaction class. The online-SI notice does not establish workspace association, so no SI fact was imported.

Classified all three Au/TiO2 cycloisomerization arrows as selected examples from the authors' cited prior work (references 5, 3, and 8c), not current-paper experiments. Each arrow has its own literature-example record.

Recorded the current uncatalyzed formation of exclusively (Z)-1′ from allenone 1 and propargylamine in dioxane at 25 °C for 10 min as quantitative. Absolute charges and isolation details remain missing.

unresolved: Scheme 1 prior-work arrows omit experiment-specific operating details and yields.
The model 1′ formation lacks absolute charges, solvent volume, analytical basis, workup, and isolated mass.

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Scheme 2 and upper-left optimization prose
regions.finding: Recorded direct 1′→1a cyclization (Au/TiO2 2 mol%, toluene, 110 °C, 12 h, complete conversion, 80% isolated) separately from one-pot Table 1 entry 1a. Recorded independent DCM and THF reflux failures and an aggregate 70–80 °C/20 h solvent-screen statement. The lower Scheme 2 Au(I)/Au(III) oxazepine arrow is cited prior work.

regions.region: page 2 middle-left one-pot, catalyst-recycling, and hot-filtration prose
regions.finding: Merged the 1 equiv allenone/1.1 equiv propargylamine/25 °C/10 min one-pot model with Table 1 product 1a. Recorded the five-run catalyst-recycling series and the separate hot-filtration no-reaction control without inventing missing run-specific yields.

regions.region: page 2 lower-right Scheme 3 and mechanistic prose
regions.finding: Recorded one proposed 6-endo cyclization/dehydrogenation/protodeauration mechanism with alternative II and III paths, GC-MS non-detection of II, and the separate inert-atmosphere same-rate control. Proposed intermediates are not preparations.

unresolved: DCM/THF failure durations and catalyst loadings are not printed.
The aggregate 70–80 °C screen cannot be split into row-specific solvent/temperature experiments.
Recycling run-specific yields and the hot-filtration/inert-control numerical conditions are incomplete.
No GC-MS detection limit for II is reported.

regions.region: page 3 right-column Table 1 header and 24 successful product arrows
regions.finding: Recorded all twenty-four successful Table 1 scope arrows independently with source-depicted substrate/amine labels, shared Au/TiO2/toluene/110 °C conditions, row times, and isolated yields. Product 1a is evidence-merged with the page-2 one-pot prose, not duplicated.

Recorded the geminally substituted allenone and secondary-propargylamine no-cyclization classes as two general limitation records. The drawings contain generic R groups, so they were not falsely represented as uniquely specified experiments.

regions.region: page 3 left-column scope/limitation prose and homopropargylamine transition
regions.finding: Confirmed the 65–80% aggregate range, internal aryl-propargylamine cases, allenyl-esters 18/19, both Table 1 limitation classes, and the current homopropargylamine/4-picoline extension. SI-only compounds 1′′/1′′′ were not imported.

Applied isolated-after-chromatography/0.2 mmol meaning to scope rows. Preserved footnote b's 77% one-millimole value as evidence for the distinct scale-up record, where it conflicts with page 4's 78%.

unresolved: Table 1 complex structures remain source-labeled where safe complete encoding was uncertain.
Generic limitation drawings do not enumerate exact substrates or row-specific times.
Scale-up source conflict: 77% in the Table 1 footnote versus 78% in the Experimental Section.

regions.finding: Recorded the generic proposed N-homopropargyl enaminone 6-exo cyclization/dehydrogenation/protodeauration mechanism. Intermediates IV/V are proposed and not isolated.

regions.region: page 4 lower-left Table 2 header, twelve successful arrows, and failure arrow
regions.finding: Recorded all twelve successful Table 2 scope arrows independently with row times/yields. Recorded the generic aryl-homopropargylamine forcing-condition failure (110 °C, 3 d, enaminone formed but no cyclization) as a limitation general scheme.

Applied 0.2 mmol substrate, 0.22 mmol amine, toluene 0.5 mL, 25 °C/10 min premix, catalyst addition, Au/TiO2 74 mg/2 mol% Au, 110 °C row-specific hold, dichloromethane-assisted silica-pad filtration, and evaporation to every concrete Table 1/2 scope record as ordered steps.

Recorded the distinct 158 mg/1.0 mmol allenone 1, 71 uL/1.1 mmol propargylamine, 3 mL toluene, 370 mg Au/TiO2 (~3.7 mg Au, 1 wt% Au), 110 °C/12 h scale-up, workup, 162 mg product, and 78% Experimental-Section yield. Retained the Table 1 footnote's conflicting 77% separately.

unresolved: Scope records omit atmosphere, individual isolated masses, and row-specific chromatography eluents.
The aryl-homopropargylamine limitation is generic and does not identify exact Ar/R or the number of substrates.
